connected_owner_review.new_function_justification: Both new functions own numerical behavior actually shared by existing callers. The precode alternatives were examined: error-only reconstructRaster cannot reasonably become a pure original permission query without a fake mutation mode; renderRuns needs binary topology without pixel recipes; composeCells retains orchestration instead of a second numerical implementation. No per-provider wrapper/handler or recursive DSL was found.

The numerical constructor owns its work preflight and returns a charged value to the caller. Geometry, ordered composition and native intersection stay in composeCells; current donor application stays in reconstructRaster; font foreground threshold remains strictly greater than127 and stroke/EDT code is unchanged.

what_this_change_does: Extracts the existing selection and four-connected topology math into two shared numerical owners, then extends them with fixed scalar predicates and a bounded original-pixel footprint pipeline. The compositor retains original/current image ownership, permission stages, native containment, local erase ordering and publication.
